content.user_title: Find the Next Step in Your PSP Workflow
content.value_statement: PSP work can stall when configuration, drafts, vocabulary, and signal sources are at different stages. This skill checks readiness and recommends the next workflow step.
actual_capabilities: Guide checks for brand configuration and SOUL.md before recommending onboarding.
Assess primary and secondary PSP draft presence using the documented configuration fields.
Check whether primary PSP vocabulary contains at least four phrases.
Recommend signal-source selection when vocabulary is ready but no source is enabled.
Recommend a refresh when the primary PSP is older than 90 days.
Present a welcome checklist or status summary with recommended next steps.
limitations: Companion skills are referenced but are not included in the reviewed file.
State detection is illustrative pseudocode, not a standalone executable implementation.
Recommendations depend on accessible configuration files and accurate draft metadata.
The routing table does not specify behavior when PSP age is exactly 90 days.

use_cases.title: Start a New PSP Program
use_cases.description: Check missing configuration and identify onboarding as the first step before drafting or signal hunting.

use_cases.title: Resume Incomplete PSP Work
use_cases.description: Review draft presence, vocabulary readiness, and signal sources to identify the next unfinished stage.

use_cases.title: Review Program Freshness
use_cases.description: Inspect refresh age and readiness before recommending a secondary PSP or downstream messaging work.

prompt_templates.title: Begin PSP Work
prompt_templates.prompt: Where do I start with PSPs? Check my project state and recommend the first step.

prompt_templates.title: Check Current Status
prompt_templates.prompt: Run /psp status. Summarize configuration, drafts, vocabulary, signal sources, and the recommended next step.

prompt_templates.title: Find the Next Unfinished Stage
prompt_templates.prompt: My primary PSP exists. Check vocabulary readiness and signal sources, then recommend the next documented workflow step.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate user resuming a partial program

prompt_templates.title: Review Refresh and Expansion Readiness
prompt_templates.prompt: Review my PSP refresh date, secondary draft, and signal sources. Recommend refresh, secondary construction, or downstream work, and identify missing information.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced user evaluating an operational program

output_examples.input: Where should I start? My project has no brand configuration.
output: Start by capturing your ideal customer profile and a primary PSP draft.
Later stages include vocabulary mining, signal-source selection, signal hunting, secondary drafts, and downstream messaging.

output_examples.input: Show status for a primary PSP refreshed 12 days ago, with eight vocabulary phrases, enabled signal sources, and no secondary draft.
output: Primary PSP: present and refreshed 12 days ago.
Vocabulary: eight phrases, meeting the readiness threshold.
Recommended next step: build a secondary PSP or continue into downstream messaging skills.

best_practices: Keep draft fields, vocabulary, signal-source settings, and refresh dates current before requesting status.
Use companion skills for onboarding, construction, and signal hunting rather than treating routing as task completion.
Use real buyer writing for vocabulary and verify readiness before starting downstream outreach.
anti_patterns: Treating sample status reports as evidence that project files have been inspected.
Expecting the kickoff router alone to build drafts, collect signals, or send outreach.
Assuming missing metadata or an unspecified routing condition means the PSP program is ready.

faq.question: What does this skill do?
faq.answer: It guides project-state checks and recommends the next PSP workflow step, including onboarding, vocabulary work, signal-source selection, or refresh.

faq.question: How is it activated?
faq.answer: It is loaded by the main psp skill on bare invocation. The file also lists questions about starting or continuing PSP work.

faq.question: Which files does it check?
faq.answer: The documented state checks use brand-config.json and SOUL.md, alongside PSP draft fields stored in the brand configuration.

faq.question: How many vocabulary phrases are required?
faq.answer: The routing threshold is at least four phrases. The welcome checklist recommends mining eight or more phrases from real buyer writing.

faq.question: When does it recommend a refresh?
faq.answer: The table recommends refresh when signal sources are configured and PSP age exceeds 90 days. Exactly 90 days is not covered.

faq.question: Does it perform signal hunting or send outreach?
faq.answer: The reviewed file recommends companion and downstream skills. It does not include signal-hunting, messaging, or outreach-sending implementations.
